documents.title: Book Closure For The Purpose Of 34Th AGM

analysis.summary: Kernex Microsystems (India) Ltd reported standalone revenue of ₹502.03 Cr and PAT of ₹109.57 Cr for Q1 FY26-27, driven by strong operational execution and scaling efficiencies. The company has a balance order book of ₹3,487 Cr and is expanding its capacity in advance of order inflows. Additionally, the company is pursuing a business diversification roadmap to transition into a diversified rail-technology and critical-infrastructure enterprise. Kernex Microsystems reported its financial and operational performance for the period ending December 2024, highlighting significant year-on-year growth in revenue, EBITDA, and PAT. Management detailed ongoing TCAS projects, order book metrics, production capacities, and future bid pipelines.
